summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before writing this plan (read-only audit, no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` tables, plus the auth stack (`modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`).  Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, everything I read is correctly wired: - Every watchlist route (`GET/POST/PUT/DELETE`) is gated by its own auth middleware, validates the `arca_session` cookie against the `sessions` table, and scopes every query
